description.ar: تعرفة خط RED العادية عندما لا تكون باقة RED فعالة: 1.5 دينار للثانية للمكالمات داخل وخارج الشبكة في محافظات الموصل وكركوك وأربيل والسليمانية ودهوك، و2.8 دينار للثانية في باقي المحافظات، والرسالة القصيرة 50 دينار.

attributes.review_note: HAND-AUTHORED from the الاسئلة المتداولة section of the FEBRA 'Line FEBRA Ar' file. ⚠ ARABIC ONLY, deliberately: the standard pay-as-you-go tariff is stated nowhere in the English or Kurdish sources, and inventing an English version would mean translating per-second call rates myself (docs/21). An English-speaking customer therefore gets no answer to this question — that is an authoring gap to fill from BSS, not a bug. ⚠ These rates are the single most consequential numbers in the seed: a wrong per-second rate is a billing complaint. Confirm against BSS before status:verified. Split out of service_red_line (2026-09-12) so a tariff question does not have to outrank the line's own overview.
